text:
Source-assisted reading of Stams, Frg. 36 (F-hmwp), made with the Leonine textus of Thomas Aquinas, Expositio libri Posteriorum (1882), and PL 64 ("Boethius" = James of Venice translation of the Posterior Analytics) available. A research reader reread on the native images all of 36-4r, all of 36-5r and the upper nine lines of 36-8r; 36-7r (18 lines) was read in the independent check. All other pieces rest on the image-only first reading. Canvases are 4912 x 7360. Expansions in parentheses; ? = uncertain; [..] = lost at the cut or unread; [x] = supplied from the edition for orientation.
